inputs.text: A graduation ceremony in Jaipur has stirred controversy after a student publicly protested against administrative issues while receiving her degree. Her remarks, made in front of the Deputy Chief Minister, have gone viral, prompting mixed reactions from the public. Many see her actions as a brave stand for student rights, while others criticize it as inappropriate for the occasion. This incident has reignited discussions about the challenges faced by students in educational institutions. As the university administration remains silent, the event continues to be a hot topic of conversation.

output.main_topic: A student’s public protest over administrative issues at a graduation ceremony in Jaipur
